Friends Abroad

ARMAN — Seoul

Hello from Korea! I live in Seoul now and I love it. My job is busy, but my colleagues are very kind and we usually have lunch together. In my free time I study Korean and I often go to the cinema. At the weekend I meet friends in a café near my flat.

Right now it's Chuseok, the autumn festival. I'm sitting in my friend's kitchen and his mother is making rice cakes. Everybody is wearing hanbok — the traditional Korean dress — and I'm wearing one too! It's blue and I look very strange in it, but nobody is laughing at me. This evening we're going to the park to see the moon.

MARIA — Lisbon

Hi everyone. I study art in Lisbon and I'm here for one year. I have classes every morning, so I don't have much free time. But in the afternoons I usually walk by the river, and on Sundays I go to the flea market. There are so many small shops here — it's much better than a shopping centre.

This week it's the Festival of Saint Anthony. Everyone is cooking sardines in the street and the whole city smells of fish and smoke. I'm standing in a square near my flat and about two hundred people are dancing. My friends are wearing paper hats and one of them is carrying a small basil plant, because that is the tradition. Tomorrow I'm going to sleep for twelve hours.

Grammar · present simple or present continuous

TUSHUNTIRISH — PRESENT SIMPLE YOKI PRESENT CONTINUOUS

Ikki zamon, ikki vazifa. Shaklni tanlashdan oldin ish qachon boʻlayotganini hal qiling.

A Present simple — odatda qiladigan ishlarimiz yoki doim toʻgʻri boʻlgan narsalar. I study Korean. · My colleagues are kind. · She goes to the market on Sundays.

B Present continuous — hozir, shu daqiqada boʻlayotgan narsalar. I'm sitting in the kitchen. · They're dancing in the square.

C Present simple bilan keladigan soʻzlar: always · usually · often · sometimes · never · every day · at weekends

D Present continuous bilan keladigan soʻzlar: now · right now · at the moment · today · this week

Shakli: present continuous = am / is / are + feʼl + -ing. Inkor: I'm not wearing… Soʻroq: Are you wearing…?

Present simple — odatda

Present continuous — hozir

I wear jeans every day.

Today I'm wearing a dress.

She works in a shop.

She's having lunch at the moment.

We don't go out on Mondays.

We aren't watching TV now.

Do you like festivals?

Are you enjoying the party?

DIQQAT — ZAMONLARNI ARALASHTIRISH

Oʻquvchilar ikki shaklni ikkala tomonga ham adashtiradi. Darslik ogohlantiradigan ikkitasi:

✗ All the masks are being really beautiful. → ✓ All the masks are really beautiful. Niqoblar faqat shu daqiqada emas, doim chiroyli. Bu — present simple.

✗ I stand in the middle of the square. → ✓ I'm standing in the middle of the square. U yerda har kuni emas, faqat hozir turibdi. Bu — present continuous.

Va be ni hech qachon unutmang: ✗ I wearing a coat. → ✓ I'm wearing a coat.

RASMIYMI YOKI NORASMIYMI?

Doʻstga va boshliqqa yoziladigan minnatdorchilik emaillari bir xil uchta joyda har xil soʻzlarni ishlatadi:

Boshlanishi: norasmiy — Hi there! · Hi Marie, · rasmiy — Dear Mr Parker, · Hello, Mrs Finch.

Minnatdorchilik: norasmiy — Thanks so much for the… · Thank you for the… · rasmiy — I'd just like to say thank you very much for the…

Tugashi: norasmiy — Love, · Thanks, · See you, · rasmiy — Best wishes, · Regards,

DIQQAT — MINNATDORCHILIK EMAILIDAGI XATOLAR

Minnatdorchilik emailida uch narsa notoʻgʻri ketadi:

1 Rasmiy va norasmiyni aralashtirish. ✗ Dear Mr Parker, … Love, Sara — bittasini tanlang va oxirigacha shunday davom eting.

2 Faqat rahmat deyish. Bir qatorli email yetarli emas. Sovgʻa bilan nima qilishingizni ayting — I'm going to wear them to the party — shunda u haqiqiy xabarga aylanadi.

3 Hozirgi zamonlarni unutish. I'm wearing them right now va I wear it every day har xil narsani aytadi. Ikkalasi ham shu yerda foydali.

5.3 Read the two emails. Then answer the questions.

Ikkala emailni oʻqing. Keyin savollarga javob bering.

EMAIL 1 — TO A FRIEND

Subject: Thank you!

Hi Malika,

Thanks so much for the earrings! They're beautiful, and gold goes with everything. I'm actually wearing them right now — I put them on this morning and I don't want to take them off. There's a wedding next month, so I'm going to wear them then too.

Let's have coffee soon.

Love, Nigora

EMAIL 2 — TO HER TEACHER

Subject: Thank you

Dear Mr Karimov,

I'd just like to say thank you very much for the book. It was very kind of you to remember my birthday. I read the first chapter last night and I'm enjoying it a lot — I usually read history, so this is something new for me.

Thank you again.

Best wishes, Nigora Rasulova
